verdict.rationale: Model-provider swapping in AutoGen is only implied. Model support ships as provider-specific extension packages (autogen-ext[openai]), teams can be defined declaratively in JSON and serialized as components, and a community report mentions pointing AutoGen at GPT-4 "and other LLMs". Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a provider-agnostic model-client abstraction, a list of supported providers/models, a documented example of swapping models without code changes, and hands-on corroboration of cross-provider portability.
